analysis.text:
By a Final Decree dated 5 May 2018, entered in partition case bearing No. 3535/P of the District Court of Nugegoda, Ajith Silva was allotted all that allotment of land marked Lot 2 depicted in Plan No. 1616 dated 2 March 2010, made by A. C. Perera, Licensed Surveyor, of the land called Kahatagahawatte, bearing Assessment No. 12, Temple Road, Nugegoda, containing in extent 15 perches.

Ajith Silva, by Deed of Gift No. 515 dated 10 December 2018, attested by P. C. Nonis, Notary Public, gifted the said Lot 2 depicted in Plan No. 1616 to Prabash Silva, the elder son of Ajith, subject to the life interest of the donor, and subject to the condition that Prabash shall not sell, mortgage or otherwise deal with the land, but may enjoy the produce thereof during his lifetime. On the death of Prabash, the property shall devolve free of all conditions to Subash, the younger son of Ajith Silva.

Ajith had three children, namely Prabash, Subash and Shehani, by his second marriage to Yamuna. Ajith had another daughter named Kushani from his first marriage to Sumana.

Ajith Silva died intestate on 2 March 2019, and Prabash Silva died intestate on 2 June 2019.

Prabash had two daughters, namely Sunali and Bimali, by his first wife Sheela, and two sons, namely Brian and Rian, by his second wife Linda. Sheela died intestate on 5 August 2019. Brian married Sara and thereafter died in an accident on 25 September 2021 without having children. Sunali died on 10 October 2023 unmarried and issueless.

1. Draw up the pedigree showing the devolution of title from Ajith Silva up to the present owners in relation to the property bearing Assessment No. 12, Temple Road, Nugegoda. **(20 marks)**
2. What are the shares presently owned by each heir in the property? **(5 marks)**

**Total: 25 marks**

claims.text: The Roman-Dutch law as it prevailed in North Holland governs the distribution of an intestate's property when the Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance is silent.
Under the Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance, a surviving spouse inherits one-half of the intestate's property.
